name: cavemio-mode-switcher
title: Mode switcher
description: Fast, Thinking, Research: a segmented switch with a sliding pill and locked paid modes.

cavemio.accessibility:
- role="radiogroup" with roving focus: Tab lands on the chosen mode, arrow keys move and skip locked modes.
- Locked modes are aria-disabled but still focusable and explained in their title.
- The pill re-measures on resize and its first placement never animates. Installs Text morph; with reduced motion the pill jumps and the description changes in place.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: onLockedSelect
props.description: – · Called when someone picks a locked mode.

props.name: showDescription
props.description: false · Show the chosen mode’s description underneath.

props.name: label
props.description: "Mode" · Accessible name of the radio group.

useCases.title: AI chat apps
useCases.description: Choose between Fast, Thinking and Research.

useCases.title: Plan-gated features
useCases.description: Show paid modes with a lock so people see what an upgrade unlocks.

useCases.title: Search and assistants
useCases.description: A quick or deep mode for the same question box.

useCases.title: Settings with a few options
useCases.description: Any choice of two to four exclusive modes, such as view or editor modes.

features.title: A pill thrown to the choice
features.description: The pill slides to the chosen mode with a little give, and its width eases to fit.

features.title: A line that says what it does
features.description: Turn on showDescription and a line underneath morphs to describe the chosen mode.

features.title: Paid modes stay visible
features.description: Locked modes show a lock. Choosing one calls onLockedSelect, for example to open pricing.

features.title: A real radio group
features.description: Tab lands on the chosen mode, arrow keys move and skip locked modes.

features.title: Controlled or not
features.description: Pass value and onValueChange, or let it keep its own selection.

features.title: Resizes cleanly
features.description: The pill re-measures on resize, and its first placement never animates.

states.title: selected
states.description: The pill is thrown to the chosen mode with a slight overshoot (460ms) while its width eases; the description below, if enabled, morphs into the new mode’s line, keeping the words they share.

states.title: locked
states.description: Visible with a lock; choosing it calls onLockedSelect (e.g. open pricing) instead of switching.
